p: Which sentence is a bounded observation?
c: Riverside Evening averaged 48.1 minutes in the six-week data
The chart proves the policy failed
why: It names an observed value and scope without inventing a cause.

p: What should follow a numerical observation in a short evidence note?
c: Population or period and a material limitation
why: Scope and limitation keep the claim interpretable.

p: Which is a valid limitation of the clinic records?
c: They do not identify the cause of waiting
They automatically represent every future week
why: Operational records describe observed waits but lack causal variables.

p: What is a restrained way to identify the support target in a chart?
c: One contrast colour plus a direct label
Use colour without a legend or label
To verify the delivered file retains title, axes, units, and target
why: The actual deliverable must be checked outside the live plotting state.

p: Which sentence improperly turns association into cause?
c: Staff shortage caused the longer waits
why: The dataset does not measure or isolate the cause.

p: Why state that 36 clinic-time-week records were analysed?
c: It defines the scope supporting the claim
